title: De-mystifying PyTorch for ASICs
description: Benchmark study across 1x H100 (RunPod), 8x H100 (Nebius), TPU v6e-8, and Trainium1 32xlarge, training image recognition and text generation models on each platform. Presented at PyTorch Conference Europe 2026 (Linux Foundation, Station F).

title: Experimental Machines
description: Independent research lab across intelligence, compute, and data — we run the benchmarks ourselves and publish the code, methods, and raw numbers. 11 accelerator platforms measured under a $376K Google TPU Research Cloud grant.

title: MI300X vs H200
description: Controlled single-GPU benchmark of inference and training on AMD MI300X vs NVIDIA H200. AMD's 1.32× paper-FLOPs lead inverts on achieved efficiency, but its 1.84× KV-cache headroom wins large-model serving outright.

title: Apple M5 vs Snapdragon X2 Elite
description: Reproducible head-to-head AI benchmark across CPU, GPU, and NPU — inference and training — with fairness rules fixed before any measurement.

title: Snapdragon 8 Elite vs Dimensity 9500s
description: Reproducible on-device AI benchmark of Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite against MediaTek Dimensity 9500s across NPU, GPU, and CPU inference and training.

title: Visual-Qwen
description: Vision-language model from the MicroMARC thesis, fine-tuned on Google TPUs to detect cognitively-degrading short-form video. Built with 10 ML experts, 20 content creators, and 20 moderators in the loop.

title: Multimodal Sludge Dataset
description: Novel multimodal (text · video · audio) dataset of 2,000+ cognitively-degrading clips scraped from TikTok and YouTube via a human-in-the-loop and synthetic-data pipeline.

title: AceRouter
description: AI agent for Philippine delivery riders that optimizes routes, drafts client messages, and maximizes earnings via conversational guidance powered by Gemini.

title: FEU Tech ACMX
description: Official cross-platform application of the FEU Tech ACM, released on Google Play, Microsoft Store, Xiaomi GetApps, and Huawei App Gallery.

title: TypeScript JobSpy
description: TypeScript job-scraping library aggregating postings from the major job boards. Production-grade rate limiting and anti-detection across 60+ countries.

title: Para Po!
description: Geospatial jeepney & transport route optimizer with an incentivized carbon-footprint reduction program. Finalist at the Philippine Junior Data Science Challenge 2024.

title: Project NATURE · NASA '24
description: Interactive 3D globe that translates the U.S. Greenhouse Gas Center dataset into a public storytelling platform for climate-change education.

title: Fireguard
description: Data-driven, community-based fire-management system leveraging satellite active-fire data to address fire incidents across the Philippines.

title: Kape ni Rab!
description: Coffee shop website built in 48 hours and crowned champion of Codetober 2024, the FEU Tech AITS web development competition.

title: Markdown Studio
description: Cross-platform markdown note-taking & blogging app. Shipped to Google Play Store and Microsoft Store with 200+ installs.

title: Setsunai · Private Space
description: Open-source, self-hosted, end-to-end-encrypted private space for thoughts that need no audience.

title: MyMNHS
description: Unofficial platform for Meycauayan National High School, complete with real-time chat, announcements, and forums. My first full-stack release.

title: Philippine Mall Explorer
description: What's inside 303 Philippine malls? 40,462 store listings from 10 operators, scraped and cleaned into a reproducible dataset on an interactive map.
